auditTrail.note: NW along the ‘greenway corridor’ (which marks the Salford Diocese – Liverpool Archdiocese boundary,  formerly the Hundred of Blackburnshire) and which separates the following streets in Salford Diocese: Great Green Lane, Tunley Holme, School Field, Clayton Brook and most of Daisy Meadow, from the following streets in Liverpool Archdiocese: The Heathers, Well Orchard and part of Daisy Meadow, to a point where it meets Preston Road A6 at Clayton Brook SW by this brook and the Ribble-Chorley civic boundary to the River Lostock and NW across the complex junction of M6 and M65.
